branchName.instructions:
Format: <type>/<short-kebab-case-description>.

Choose exactly one type:
- "content" for Japanese site copy, images, events, page content, and site links.
- "docs" for documentation related to the repository like README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, AGENTS.md, etc.
- "fix" for broken or incorrect site behavior, layout, accessibility, or functionality.
- "feature" for one cohesive new or expanded capability.

Use a concise, specific, lowercase kebab-case description. Do not use any other prefix.

pullRequest.instructions: Start every PR body with "Closes #<issue-number>" (for example, "Closes #5") to automatically link it to the corresponding GitHub Issue. Describe the changes made in plain English after that statement.
